name: The Scaglietti
source:
The insurance company sends you to oversee the restoration of paintings supervised by professor Claudia Ascari. However, soon there appears to be evidence of a possible crime.

[From [url=https://atpprojects.itch.io/scaglietti]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
保險公司派你監督由Claudia Ascari教授主持的畫作修復工作。然而不久，現場似乎出現了與某起犯罪有關的證據。

[摘自[url=https://atpprojects.itch.io/scaglietti]Itch.io[/url]]
